The '''Vanderijar''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At one point, forces loyal to clan members [[Mennac Vanderijar|Mennac]] and [[Jobwah]] fought against forces of the [[Grim Destiny]], a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunting]] group led by [[Garm Trodask]]. This skirmish took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trendivar]].<ref name="THtH">{{WEGCite|story=To Hunt the Hutt|book=Imperial Entanglements (Star Wars Miniatures Battles)}}</ref>

During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the Galactic Civil War, Vanderijar held a seat on the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Ruling Council]], the ruling body of the Hutt [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="LoNH" />
